title: Network
description: Proxies provide fixed outbound addresses loaded when workers claim accounts. Credentials are stored encrypted; APIs only report whether auth is set.

binding.abnormalTooltip: Some bound accounts are abnormal (needs code / frozen / invalid / dead / disabled). Inspect accounts or switch proxy.

empty.title: No proxies yet
empty.description: Create a proxy and bind accounts in bulk to route them through a fixed exit.

footnote: Health hints reflect the statuses of bound accounts; fix abnormal accounts first or switch to a more stable endpoint.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete proxy "{{name}}"?
deleteConfirm.content: Bound accounts will not be deleted, but they will lose their outbound address until rebound.

bindModal.title: Bind Accounts to Proxy: {{name}}
bindModal.hint: Check to route through this proxy, uncheck to unbind and use direct connection.

form.parseHint: Paste a full endpoint to auto-parse (socks5://user:pass@1.2.3.4:1080), or fill in the fields below manually.
form.parseError: Unable to parse host. Check endpoint format (e.g. socks5://user:pass@1.2.3.4:1080).
form.parseSuccess: Endpoint parsed into fields below — review and save.
form.hostErrScheme: Omit the protocol prefix (scheme://); choose protocol from the dropdown
form.hostErrPath: Do not include a path or query string
